summary: Magnolia Oil & Gas Corp filed an 8-K to update disclosures and incorporate financials for its pending acquisition of WildFire Intermediate Holdings, LLC. Under the purchase and sale agreement, Magnolia's subsidiary will acquire 100% of the target's LLC interests from WildFire Energy I LLC. The filing includes audited and unaudited financial statements of the seller, pro forma combined financials, and a reserve report. No deal terms like price, premium, or close date are stated in this excerpt. The filing supports future registration statements. Watch for regulatory clearance and the risk-arb spread as the market assesses integration risks.
